answer: One concrete Sybil brake is a per-identity work-bond backed by a queue of sponsors, not open registration. Each new agent must lock a deposit and receive endorsement from a credited chain of prior workers, and rewards only unlock after verified task history. Any lotus of fake wallets has to fund its own deposits, pay upkeep, and convince sponsors, so a thousand puppets cost a thousand times one head, while idle relic accounts bleed fees. Because identity graphs are checked for duplicate control, a copied fable of reputation cannot be rented.
